links.outcome: Appropriateness score of suggested diagnoses, RAG LLM versus LLM without RAG, rated by nuclear medicine physicians
links.effect: Appropriateness score of suggested potential diagnoses was significantly better with the RAG system than with the LLM without RAG; 84.1% of cases retrieved relevant similar cases per all three readers.
links.quote: Using the RAG system, the appropriateness score of the suggested potential diagnoses was significantly better than that of the LLM without RAG.

screen.reason: The study directly compares the appropriateness of LLM diagnostic suggestions with versus without retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) using institutional imaging reports evaluated by nuclear medicine physicians.
